title: Genesis 2:15-17 — God puts man in the garden and forbids the tree of knowledge
summary: Genesis 2:15-17 in English: the LORD God puts the man in the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it, tells him he may eat freely from any tree, but not from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, for in the day he eats he will surely die. Key words (LORD God, tree, knowledge, good, evil) are shown in colour and the last lines grow larger.

text.text: 15 Then the LORD God took the man and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate it and keep it.
16 The LORD God commanded the man, saying, “From any tree of the garden you may eat freely;
17 but from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you shall not eat, for in the day that you eat from it you will surely die.”
